title: Beyond Remediation: A Mitigate-First Guide for CISOs
content_md: Beyond Remediation: A Mitigate-First Guide for CISOs You answer for exposure risk, but the teams that fix it report to someone else. So a known exposure stays open while the fix waits on testing, a maintenance window, or a third party. And the only progress you can report is a remediation ticket that hasn’t moved. Article Link: Beyond Remediation: A Mitigate-First Guide for CISOs
